text: God, help me to remember this is true: that even though it feels like in this moment things are not what they should be, that in the big whole picture you've got me, that in the big whole picture you're doing a beautiful work. But it feels like right now, God, I am struggling to say, "You're never going to let me down" because I feel right now let down. That's that's this moment, angered with everything that's happening, filled with grief. We're hanging up our ladders. We're not playing an instrument right now.
